messages:
sam: quick check — bringing up rerank-v3 (int8 ptq) on shadowbench and seeing NDCG stable but MRR down ~6% on longtail cohort. any obvious suspects?
anya: hmm, int8 often shifts top1. do we have candidate ordering parity between offline bench and prod bringup?
jorge: can confirm ordering parity. i ran a quick compare: topk candidate slots same set, but we saw subtle score compressions near the head.
ciara: do you have the sample id(s)? can run a small ablation with kvpack disabled.
sam: sample ids: 4492, 4498, 4501. disabling kvpack in the runner reduces latency but not MRR delta — still down ~5%.
anya: curious — maybe query/document formatting mismatch after token-wrap changes. did the preprocessing patch for doc boundary wrapping land before this quant run?
jorge: yes, preprocess v2 added `wrap_docs=True` to serializer a day before PTQ job. that could nudge soft-ties if model is sensitive to prefix tokens.
ciara: try re-running eval harness with `wrap_docs=False` to match prior baseline. also compare top1 tie counts.
sam: re-ran with wrap_docs=False on the holdout: MRR delta goes to -0.8% (much smaller). looks like wrap_docs interacts badly with int8.
anya: nice find. hypothesis: wrapping adds delim tokens that shift logits magnitude distribution; PTQ calibration didn't see that pattern.
ciara: short-term mitigation: force `wrap_docs=False` in bringup for int8 variants and add an eval checkpoint with wrapped docs + quantized calibration.
jorge: on the bench side, i can add a slot-normalization step: normalize candidate text by slot position (strip slot prefixes) and see if that reduces head compression.
sam: can you paste the small experiment script?
jorge: sure — snippet: ```python
def normalize_slot(text, slot):
    return re.sub(fr'^slot:\d+\s+', '', text)
```
ciara: also add a tiny eval that reports `tie_fraction = sum(1 for r in ranks if r[0]==r[1]) / len(ranks)` and `top1_shift = mean(new_top1!=old_top1)` so we can quantify.
sam: adding to the runbook now. run ids: run-2026-03-22-a (wrap_on + int8), run-2026-03-22-b (wrap_off + int8), run-2026-03-22-c (wrap_on + float16).
eval-bot: quick report for run-2026-03-22-a: N=12,000, ndcg@10 delta +0.2%, mrr delta -5.9%, tie_fraction +1.6%.
eval-bot: run-2026-03-22-b: N=12,000, ndcg@10 delta +0.1%, mrr delta -0.9%, tie_fraction +0.4%.
anya: pattern is consistent. next steps: 1) pin wrap_docs=False for int8 bringups, 2) re-calibrate PTQ with wrapped-docs data augmentation, 3) schedule a micro-benchmark to test slot-normalization impact.
ciara: i'll own the calibration augmentation — will add wrapped-docs examples to the calibration corpus and re-generate quant params.
sam: thanks. can we also add a quick note to the onboarding checklist: "if preproc changed upstream, re-run PTQ calibration with matching preprocess config". short blurb in runbook will avoid this.
anya: +1, please include a short test in CI that compares tie_fraction between baseline and candidate; fail if >1% regression for longtail slice.
jorge: will add the CI test tonight.
ciara: filing a tiny ops ticket to force wrap_docs=False on current int8 canary until recalibration done.
sam: perfect — thanks all. will follow up after calibration runs. :thumbsup:
